no: Nordic cross. Red field with a white-bordered BLUE cross. (Iceland is the color-inverse: blue field, red cross.)
is: Nordic cross. Blue field with a white-bordered RED cross — the color-inverse of Norway.
dk: Nordic cross. Plain white cross on red, with no extra border — the original Nordic flag (Dannebrog).
se: Nordic cross. Yellow cross on a blue field.
fi: Nordic cross. Blue cross on a white field.
fo: Nordic cross. Red cross with a blue border on white.
nl: Red-white-blue horizontal. Brighter red and a deeper blue than Luxembourg.
lu: Red-white-blue horizontal, like the Netherlands but a lighter sky-blue and a longer shape.
ru: White-blue-red horizontal bands, no emblem. Slovakia and Slovenia share these colors but add a coat of arms.
si: White-blue-red with a coat of arms (Mt. Triglav peak + stars) in the upper hoist.
sk: White-blue-red with a coat of arms (double cross on three hills) set just right of the hoist.
py: Red-white-blue horizontal — the only national flag with DIFFERENT emblems on its two sides.
id: Two bands, RED over WHITE. Monaco is nearly identical but squarer; Poland is the inverse (white over red).
mc: Red over white — like Indonesia, but a more square proportion.
pl: White over red — the inverse of Indonesia and Monaco.
sg: Red over white, with a white crescent and five stars in the upper hoist.
ro: Blue-yellow-red vertical, no emblem. Chad is the same but with a darker, navy blue.
td: Blue-yellow-red vertical — like Romania, but the blue band is a darker indigo/navy.
ad: Blue-yellow-red vertical with a coat of arms in the center.
md: Blue-yellow-red vertical with a central eagle coat of arms.
ie: Green-white-orange vertical, with GREEN at the hoist (left edge).
ci: Orange-white-green vertical — the mirror of Ireland, with ORANGE at the hoist.
gn: Red-yellow-green vertical — the reverse color order of Mali.
sn: Green-yellow-red vertical like Mali, but with a green star in the center.
it: Green-white-red vertical, no emblem. Mexico adds a central eagle crest.
mx: Green-white-red vertical with a central eagle-and-snake coat of arms.
co: Yellow-blue-red horizontal; the yellow band is double height, no emblem.
ec: Yellow-blue-red horizontal with a central coat of arms (condor).
ve: Yellow-blue-red horizontal with an arc of eight white stars in the center.
cl: White over red, with a blue square and single white star in the upper hoist.
cu: Five blue-and-white stripes with a red triangle and single white star at the hoist.
ar: Light blue-white-light blue with a golden 'Sun of May' in the center.
uy: Nine blue-and-white stripes with a Sun of May in the upper-hoist canton.
cz: White over red with a BLUE triangle at the hoist.
ph: Blue over red with a white triangle (sun + three stars) at the hoist.
in: Saffron-white-green horizontal with a navy 24-spoke wheel (Ashoka Chakra) in the center.
ne: Orange-white-green horizontal with a plain orange circle in the center.
au: Blue ensign with a Union Jack, a large 7-point Commonwealth star, and the Southern Cross — all stars WHITE.
nz: Blue ensign with the Southern Cross shown as FOUR red, white-bordered stars (no Commonwealth star).
bh: White and RED, divided by a 5-point serrated edge.
qa: White and MAROON, divided by a 9-point serrated edge (and a longer flag).
jo: Black-white-green bands with a red hoist triangle containing a white 7-point star.
ps: Black-white-green bands with a plain red hoist triangle — like Jordan without the star.
sd: Red-white-black bands with a green hoist triangle.
eg: Red-white-black bands with the golden Eagle of Saladin in the center.
iq: Red-white-black bands with the green takbir script centered on the white band.
kw: Green-white-red bands with a black trapezoid at the hoist.
ae: Green-white-black horizontal bands with a vertical red band at the hoist.
ye: Plain red-white-black horizontal bands, no emblem.
tr: Red field with an off-center white crescent and star.
tn: Red field with a white circle containing a red crescent and star (centered).
